evals.expected_output: Locates conflicted revisions via the conflicts() revset and resolves them oldest-first via jj edit + hand-merge or :ours/:theirs.
evals.prompt: After rebasing my shikanime jj stack there are still conflicted revisions — resolve them without redoing the rebase.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-converge'

Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body mentions 'conflicts()' as the locator revset
Body mentions 'jj edit' and 'jj resolve --tool :theirs' or ':ours'

evals.expected_output: Explains the jj conflict-marker dialect (%%%% diff-from = destination side, ++++++ = rebased revision side) so files are merged, not mangled.
evals.prompt: My conflicted jj file has %%%%%%% diff from blocks instead of git markers — which side is which?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-converge'
Body documents that the '%%%%%%% diff from:' block is the destination side
Body documents that the '+++++++ <rev>' block is the rebased revision's change

evals.expected_output: Treats 'Won't push commit since it has conflicts' as the gate: converge until both revsets are empty, then push.
evals.prompt: jj git push fails with "Won't push commit 14626d7a since it has conflicts" — how do I get it pushable?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-converge'
Body states jj git push rejects conflicted commits
Body requires both conflicts() and divergent() empty before push
Body does not recommend force-push or --admin bypass

evals.expected_output: Reconverges divergent twins by abandoning the loser and repointing the bookmark with the mandatory /N offset form.
